info.title: API.SH: PUMA
info.description: The PUMA API from API.SH: public PUMA data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One PUMA product (style) with every colour: per colour the price and sale price, discount, orderable and final-sale flags, badges, gender, material, care, keywords, story, country of origin, EAN/UPC, every size (group, label, size code, product id, orderable, maximum quantity) and images; plus the style's description, brand line, division, category, rating, review count, promotions, size measurements and link. Pass a colour (399781_01 or ?swatch=01 in a link) to get only that colour.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/puma-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Style number (e.g. 399781), style_colour (399781_01) or a us.puma.com product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Customer reviews of a PUMA product: rating, title, text, date, purchase date, recommended and incentivized flags, author (first name and last initial) with nickname, location, age range and profile answers when given, helpful votes, the quality/value/fit/size ratings, the reviewed SKU and photos; with the total count. 20 per page (up to 50).

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/puma-reviews

get.description:
Search PUMA's US store (us.puma.com) by keywords with every filter and sort the site offers. Each product (one per colour): style and colour ids, name, header and sub-header, brand line, price, sale and promotion price, discount, orderable flag, out-of-stock label, badges, promotions, app-exclusive flag, rating and review count, every colour on offer, EAN, images and link, plus `raw`. Also returns `filters` (ids, values and counts) and `sort_options`. 24 per page (up to 48 with `limit`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/puma-search

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort id from `sort_options`: top-sellers, newest, price-low-to-high, price-high-to-low.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A filter as id:value (several values comma-separated), repeatable, e.g. `gender:Men` and `size:10,10.5`. Ids and values as `filters` lists them.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Units on hand per size for one colour of a PUMA product: size label and code, product id, orderable, quantity and a limited-availability flag.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/puma-stock

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: style_colour like 399781_01 (or a product link with ?swatch=); a bare style number uses its first colour.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
